status: source-only proposal; no target tokenization or selection performed
population: All 312 reviewed body physical rows only, in frozen existing source order. Final repaired row manifest and its SHA256 must be pinned by root before execution.

tokenization.rowTraversal: Existing conventional source order, page then frozen region then physical row; no row, region, page or paragraph reset.
tokenization.keepChunkPredicate: Contains at least one ASCII A-Z, a-z or 0-9, tested before wrapper stripping.
tokenization.stripRule: Repeatedly remove only members of outerWrapperCharacters from the beginning and end. Do not remove any interior character. Retain the remaining chunk exactly.
literalRetentions: All hyphens, including physical row-ending hyphens
All slash characters, including a row-ending slash
Currency symbols, including a leading dollar sign
forbidden: Punctuation deletion beyond the registered outer-wrapper rule

selection.rule: For the direction-specific token sequence T, select T[p], T[p+12], T[p+24], ... while in range. Reverse means reverse the entire token sequence before applying this rule. No other reset or reversal.

projections.words: Join selected cleaned chunks in order with exactly one U+0020 ASCII space.
projections.initials: Concatenate the first remaining Unicode character of every selected cleaned chunk.
projections.finals: Concatenate the last remaining Unicode character of every selected cleaned chunk.

projectionTerminology: Initials/finals are literal first/last core glyphs, not inferred linguistic word letters. Thus final hyphens, censor stars and slash characters remain possible. This is one declared model, not a test of all linguistic letter policies.
streamCountRule: Emit all 2 x 12 x 3 records, even if a reading is empty or duplicates another. Report nominal count, unique count and actual evaluation counts separately; do not call duplicates extra hypotheses.
formatEvaluation: Use the separately frozen four-format evaluator and its preregistered exact/whitespace-only-compacted forms, without any additional punctuation deletion or source filtering. Format leads remain private pending source review; no network checks are authorized by this proposal.

sourceUncertainty.executionModel: Execute the single frozen repaired-OCR model, retaining the unchanged prior strings in the three uncertain leading-word spans. No branch over alternative spellings.

uncertainTokens.physicalChunk: First chunk containing ASCII alphanumeric characters in that row
uncertainTokens.uncertainty: Leading glyph/prefix not source-certified; word boundary/count and terminal glyph are source-certified by the independent third review.

sourceUncertainty.executionModelComplete: True after all finite declared readings are evaluated against the pinned model, regardless of source uncertainty.
sourceUncertainty.physicalSourceComplete: For words and initials, true only if selected token positions avoid all three uncertain-prefix tokens. For finals, true because all relevant final glyphs, including l/e/s for these three tokens, are source-certified. Record the projection-specific rule without guessing the unknown prefixes.
sourceUncertainty.negativeLanguage: No strict-format lead in the 72 readings of this frozen repaired-OCR model. Separately report how many readings used no uncertain token; source-affected readings cannot exclude the corresponding physical-source reading.
sourceUncertainty.hitLanguage: Any words/initials lead involving an uncertain-prefix token depends on the provisional OCR spelling and needs source confirmation before significance is assigned. A finals reading uses only source-certified terminal glyphs; this certifies its input glyphs, not the cryptographic hypothesis.
sourceUncertainty.punctuationOnlyUncertainty: The p79 leading elision quote before til is removed regardless of its curly orientation because both U+2018 and U+2019 are in the fixed wrapper set. A standalone en/em dash after day has no ASCII alphanumeric and is not a counted token in this declared model. Neither requires a model branch.
sourceUncertainty.finalGlyphEvidence: Root reports an independent blinded third source review visibly certifying the final glyphs l/e/s of the three affected words. This proposal accepts that explicit source receipt; the earlier page81 review conservatively left row3 final-glyph evidence unresolved.

syntheticControlDesign.purpose: Checks censor stars, abbreviation periods, no wrap join, slash, currency retention, internal apostrophe and punctuation-only exclusion.
All three possible leading elision-quote glyphs produce the same declared core; this does not add guessed letters.

syntheticControlDesign.inputDesign: Twenty-four toy cleaned chunks a00 through a23, in that order.
syntheticControlDesign.purpose: Detects phase off-by-one and reversing selected output rather than reversing the full input before selection.

syntheticControlDesign.inputDesign: The same 24 toy chunks spread over two rows and two pages at nonmultiples of 12.
syntheticControlDesign.expected: Exactly the same phase-direction outputs as the one-row fixture.

syntheticControlDesign.inputDesign: Mark only the leading glyph/prefix of toy token a05 uncertain, with final glyph 5 source-certified; all other toy tokens source-certified.
syntheticControlDesign.expected: Forward phase5 words and initials are source-affected; its finals reading remains physicalSourceComplete. Forward phase6 is physicalSourceComplete for all three projections. All emitted readings remain executionModelComplete after evaluation.
syntheticControlDesign.purpose: Separates completion of a fixed model from physical-source exclusion.

syntheticControlDesign.inputDesign: A short or deliberately repetitive toy population.
syntheticControlDesign.expected: Always 72 nominal records; empty or identical readings have separately reported unique/evaluated counts and do not inflate hypothesis counts.
syntheticControlDesign.purpose: Controls finite-count reporting without changing the extraction.

negativeCriterion: Complete the fixed 72 nominal readings and declared evaluator scope. A model-negative requires zero format-valid private leads and no execution errors. Report source-complete and source-affected subsets separately; any error is inconclusive, never negative.
limitations: Source support is the printed duplicated 12-step passage and routine/recursion language; it motivates this single exploratory interval but does not establish an instruction to stride12.
The conventional frozen body-row order and ASCII-alphanumeric-containing chunk definition are explicit model assumptions.
A negative does not exclude hard-wrap joining, linguistic last-letter policies, alternate readings of uncertain prefixes, other article populations or arbitrary encodings.
